These programs are packed inside Turris Studio and unpacked on first launch.
They run as separate programs.

ffmpeg and ffprobe
  GPLv3 essentials build 9.0.2 by Gyan
  https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/9.0.2
  Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/946fcce07b
  License: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

yt-dlp
  Standalone executable nightly 2026.10.10.233141, Unlicense
  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds/releases/tag/2026.10.10.233141

qjs
  QuickJS-ng v0.17.0, MIT License
  https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/releases/tag/v0.17.0
